text:
Sam: Heads-up: Compliance wants 24mo availability for auth + session logs. We currently keep 90d raw + 1y redacted. Need a compact policy for long-tail access: separate CMK, JIT unwrap, RBAC roles, and replay throttles.

Rhea: Proposal sketch: store 24mo encrypted in archive-bucket (CMK=archive-cmk). No direct raw views. Access only via ticketed JIT unwrap with MFA and at least one security approver. Short-lived presigned URLs for downloads (TTL=15m).

Jorge: Ops constraints: large restores can saturate SIEM ingest. Default replay throttle 400 ev/s per tenant; require SRE coordination for >1M events and manifest export for >2M. Honor 429 from SIEM connector and exponential backoff. Tag all jobs with ticket id + cost-center.

Sam: Audit requirements: every unwrap must emit an immutable record (requestor, approvers, token id, objects touched, bytes delivered). Retain unwrap audit for 5y. Key policy: only unwrap-service principal can call kms:Decrypt, conditioned on ticket id attribute.

Rhea: RBAC items: create roles 'archive_reviewer' (can request), 'archive_unwrapper' (can approve + execute unwrap). Grants require ticket link, MFA, and audit signature. Day-to-day analysts get 'search_redacted' access to scrubbed indices only.

security-bot: TASK-9012 created: "Design 24mo archive access + runbook" assigned to Rhea.

oncall-sre: Runbook additions: enforce off-peak windows for big restores, automatic queueing for jobs that exceed throttle, and presigned URL rotation. Add SIEM ingest metrics alert to auto-pause large replays if error rate >5%.

Sam: Action items:
- Rhea: draft KMS key policy + ticket schema (due 2025-02-07)
- Jorge: add replay throttle + manifest gating to SRE runbook and test harness (due 2025-01-30)
- Sam: update compliance response and evidence retention plan (due 2025-02-03)

Please ack.

Rhea: ack :+1:

Jorge: ack :thumbsup:
